truncation.label: Loaded {{n}} rows; there are more
truncation.hint: This list is capped. Only the loaded rows are shown; absence here does not prove that an evaluation record does not exist.

title: Evals
description: Quality scorecards, run results, A/B comparisons and drift — measured against versioned golden suites. Outputs are never stored; only scores and hash fingerprints.

forbidden.title: Not authorized
forbidden.description: You need the evals read permission to view quality measurements.

scorecards.title: Quality scorecards
scorecards.description: Mean score, pass-rate and trend per subject, aggregated on read.
scorecards.empty: No scorecards yet — run an eval against a golden suite.

runs.title: Eval runs
runs.description: Each run scores a subject against a suite version. A regression is marked here; the finding is handled by the security view.

cases.title: {{subject}} — case results
cases.description: Per-case outcome and score for this run.
cases.noPayload: The candidate output is never stored — each case carries only a one-way fingerprint and a short clamped label, never an expandable payload.
cases.empty: No case results for this run.

ab.title: A/B comparison
ab.description: Two prompt variants scored against the same suite; the higher score wins, ties are explicit.
ab.seamNote: An A/B comparison is a privileged write through POST /ab; the engine exposes no stored comparison to read back.
ab.pickerDescription: Pick the suite, then provide the candidate outputs each variant produced.
ab.runError: The A/B comparison could not be run. Try again.
ab.empty: No A/B comparison has been run in this session.
ab.emptyDescription: A result appears only after the privileged POST /ab write completes. There is no GET endpoint for a stored comparison.
ab.noSuites: No suites yet. A comparison is scored against a suite's cases, so create one first.
ab.outputsHint: JSON object mapping case_key to the output that variant produced. The engine scores them and keeps only a hash — the text is never stored.
ab.outputsInvalid: Not a JSON object mapping case_key to output text.
ab.outputsEmpty: Provide at least one case output. An empty set scores nothing and would be stored as a run with no result.
ab.pairwiseHint: Judges each shared case twice with the two candidates' order swapped, and counts a win only when both orders agree. Two judge calls per case (billable) and the suite must carry a criterion.
ab.pairwiseCounts: {{compared}} compared · {{aWins}} A · {{bWins}} B · {{ties}} ties · {{inconsistent}} order-inconsistent · {{errors}} errors
ab.outputsTooLong: A case key must be at most {{maxKey}} characters and an output at most {{maxOutput}}. The engine truncates longer values and scores the truncated text.
ab.pairwiseSkippedBody: The engine did not run the judged comparison. Its reason:

drift.title: Drift — {{subject}}
drift.description: Score over time against the suite pass threshold; a sustained decline is degradation.
drift.note: The threshold line is the suite pass threshold; points below it failed the bar at that time.

caseResults.title: No case outcomes recorded for this run
caseResults.description: The run must score or skip cases from its selected suite before per-case outcomes, scores and fingerprints appear here.

runs.title: No eval runs recorded yet
runs.description: A caller must submit candidate outputs against a versioned golden suite through the eval run API before a scored run appears here.

gate.title: CI gate
gate.description: Regression gate evaluations: what the gate measured, and what CI must act on.
gate.overrideDescription: A written reason is required. It is recorded beside the original verdict, in the row and in the evidence ledger.
gate.reasonHint: Why this gate is being overridden. The original verdict is not erased.
gate.correctedRate: Bias-corrected pass rate {{rate}} (judge sensitivity {{sens}}, specificity {{spec}}) — shown alongside the raw rate, never instead of it.
gate.noCorrection: No bias-corrected estimate: there is no trusted calibration to correct with, so the raw rate is unadjusted — that is not the same as the two agreeing.

calibration.title: Judge calibration
calibration.description: How far the LLM judge agrees with human labels. A set that cannot measure chance-corrected agreement cannot certify anything.

calibItems.title: Reference set
calibItems.description: The human labels the judge is measured against — and the reason a report can or cannot certify.
calibItems.degenerate: ⛔ Every label is the same, so kappa CANNOT be computed and no report from this set can certify. Label cases of the other kind.
calibItems.noJudge: No judge is wired, so there is nothing to measure. This is not an outage and not an edition limit: a calibration cannot be simulated.

baseline.replaceWarning: ⛔ There is ONE baseline per suite and subject, and it is mutable. Pinning does not add — it REPLACES whatever is currently the baseline for {{suite}} / {{subject}}. Every future regression is measured against it.
baseline.cannotShowCurrent: The console cannot show what this replaces: POST /baselines is the only route the engine exposes, and the previous reference is recorded in the self-audit rather than in a readable endpoint. Pinning a WORSE run lowers the bar, which is how a quality gate stops firing without anyone disabling it.
